test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

S has the exam on Thursday. Only one person has the exam between S and V. Q has the exam on the day immediately before V but not on a Monday. Only two people have exams between Q and U. P's exam is on one of the days before T but on one of the days after R. Who among the following has the exam on Monday?
solution:
**Given: **Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

1) S has the exam on Thursday.

2) Only one person has the exam between S and V. 

3) Q has the exam on the day immediately before V but not on a Monday.
